SELECT GC.GROUP_CODE , GC.GROUP_CODE_NAME , GC.USE_YN , GC.SORT_ORDER , GC.CREATED_BY , GC.CREATED_AT , GC.UPDATED_BY , GC.UPDATED_AT , CC.GROUP_CODE AS COMMON_CODE_GROUP_CODE , CC.COMMON_CODE , CC.COMMON_CODE_NAME , CC.USE_YN AS COMMON_CODE_IS_USE , CC.SORT_ORDER , CC.CREATED_AT AS COMMON_CODE_CREATED_AT , CC.CREATED_BY AS COMMON_CODE_CREATED_BY , CC.UPDATED_AT AS COMMON_CODE_UPDATED_AT , CC.UPDATED_BY AS COMMON_CODE_UPDATED_BY FROM TB_GROUP_CODE GC LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE CC ON GC.GROUP_CODE = CC.GROUP_CODE AND CC.DEL_YN != 'Y'
ORDER BY GC.SORT_ORDER, CC.SORT_ORDER

SELECT GC.GROUP_CODE , GC.GROUP_CODE_NAME , GC.USE_YN , GC.SORT_ORDER , GC.CREATED_BY , GC.CREATED_AT , GC.UPDATED_BY , GC.UPDATED_AT , CC.GROUP_CODE AS COMMON_CODE_GROUP_CODE , CC.COMMON_CODE , CC.COMMON_CODE_NAME , CC.USE_YN AS COMMON_CODE_IS_USE , CC.SORT_ORDER , CC.CREATED_AT AS COMMON_CODE_CREATED_AT , CC.CREATED_BY AS COMMON_CODE_CREATED_BY , CC.UPDATED_AT AS COMMON_CODE_UPDATED_AT , CC.UPDATED_BY AS COMMON_CODE_UPDATED_BY FROM TB_GROUP_CODE GC LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE CC ON GC.GROUP_CODE = CC.GROUP_CODE AND CC.DEL_YN != 'Y'
ORDER BY GC.SORT_ORDER, CC.SORT_ORDER
